name: query_entity
description: Query a Folketinget (Danish Parliament) OData v3 entity collection. Returns matching rows under the `value` array. Fields and values are in Danish (e.g. titel=title, navn=name, opdateringsdato=last-updated). Supports OData $filter/$orderby/$expand/$select with $top/$skip paging. Example filters: "year(opdateringsdato) eq 2024", "substringof('klima',titel)", "typeid eq 3".

entity.description: Danish entity name: Sag (cases/bills), Aktør (politicians/committees/parties), Afstemning (votes), Stemme (individual votes), Møde (meetings), Dokument, Sagstrin.

skip.description: OData $skip — rows to skip for paging.

expand.description: OData $expand — related entities to inline, e.g. "Stemme" or "Sagstrin".

name: get_entity_by_id
description: Fetch a single Folketinget entity record by its numeric id, e.g. Sag(1). Returns the record object directly (not wrapped in `value`). Use $expand to inline related entities.

entity.description: Danish entity name: Sag (cases/bills), Aktør (politicians/committees/parties), Afstemning (votes), Stemme (individual votes), Møde (meetings), Dokument, Sagstrin.

expand.description: OData $expand — related entities to inline, e.g. "Sagstrin" or "Stemme".

name: search_cases
description: Convenience search over Sag (cases/bills): finds cases whose Danish title (titel) contains a substring. Sorted by most recently updated. Use this to look up legislation/matters by keyword; for full control use query_entity.

query.description: Substring to match in the Danish case title (titel), e.g. "klima", "skat", "sundhed".

name: document_text
description: Return the full TEXT of a Folketinget (Danish Parliament) document by its numeric Dokument id -- e.g. a minister's final answer to a committee question (udvalgsspørgsmål), a bill text, a consultation reply. Resolves the Dokument record, fetches its published file and extracts the text (PDF or Word; the declared file format is not trusted, the bytes are sniffed). Returns title, date, the question wording (spørgsmålsordlyd), who answered/asked, the extracted text, and a `reason` when no text could be read (file missing, scanned image, unsupported type) so an empty text is never ambiguous. Long texts are paged with offset/max_chars. Source: Folketinget, parliamentary document register.

document_id.description: Numeric Dokument id, e.g. 1237262 (the id used by get_entity_by_id with entity "Dokument").

max_chars.description: Max characters of text to return (default 100000, max 400000).

offset.description: Character offset into the extracted text, for paging a long document (default 0).
